About.title: About Me
About.p1: I am a 23-year-old software engineer, a graduate of the School of Management and Banking in Krakow. I have many years of programming experience, gained through commercial projects and developing my own initiatives. My passion is cybersecurity, which translates into a commitment to robust and secure solutions in every project.
About.p2: I specialize in creating web, desktop, and mobile applications using modern technologies such as React, Next.js, Java Spring Boot, and Electron. I am constantly expanding my knowledge, also taking an interest in blockchain technology and cryptocurrencies.
About.p3: In my projects, I focus on security, performance, and delivering value to the user. I can work in a team as well as independently manage projects from concept to deployment. I am eager to take on new challenges and look for innovative solutions.

Skills.title: Skills
Skills.manifestoTitle: There is no such thing as a frontend developer
Skills.manifestoLead: Calling yourself "frontend" or "backend" is not a specialization. It is a ceiling you build for yourself, and then decorate.
Skills.manifestoBody: Every bug worth solving lives on a boundary — in the query behind the spinner, in the cache between the CDN and the render, in the token that expired two layers below the button. Whoever refuses to cross that boundary never sees the whole bug, only their half of it.
Skills.quoteLaw: All non-trivial abstractions, to some degree, are leaky.
Skills.quoteFollow: The only way to deal with the leaks competently is to learn about how the abstractions work and what they are abstracting.

Projects.title: Projects
Projects.noScreenshots: Due to the sensitive nature of the data and the restrictive provisions of the Non-Disclosure Agreement (NDA), visual documentation and interface screenshots cannot be publicly disclosed.
Projects.expTriumphoDesc: Backend of a social platform built as a modular Spring Boot service. I work on the domain modules and on the infrastructure that carries them.
Projects.expTriumphoB1: Domain modules for posts, lobbies, media, moderation and recommendations, each kept independent behind its own API.
Projects.expTriumphoB2: Authentication and authorisation on Keycloak with an OAuth2 resource server, PostgreSQL with Flyway migrations, and Kafka for asynchronous flows between modules.
Projects.expTriumphoB3: Containerised delivery with Docker and Helm charts, an OpenAPI contract for client teams, and a Spock/Groovy test suite.
Projects.expIcdz: Interdisciplinary Health Data Center, Jagiellonian University Collegium Medicum
Projects.expIcdzDesc: Internal tooling that research teams use to standardise, explore and publish health data — from ETL pipelines to a GPU platform running local language models. Descriptions below stay at the level of architecture and technology; the data itself is confidential.
Projects.expIcdzB1: Tooling around the OMOP Common Data Model: mapping, validation and import pipelines that turn source records into a standardised research schema.
Projects.expIcdzB2: A terminology dictionary with a four-role editorial workflow, a verification queue, affiliation checks and optional TOTP two-factor authentication — a statically exported Next.js frontend over a FastAPI service.
Projects.expIcdzB3: An in-house platform for running local LLMs on a two-GPU host: launching GGUF models as llama.cpp containers from the browser, VRAM feasibility estimates computed from model metadata, and live telemetry over WebSocket.
Projects.expIcdzB4: Volumetric 3D density estimation ported from Mathematica into a Python library, served by FastAPI and plotted in the browser.
Projects.expNzozDesc: Website for a public healthcare institution in Kraków, built as a static site with no backend to maintain.
Projects.expNzozB1: Statically generated with Next.js — near-instant loads and strong SEO scores.
Projects.expNzozB2: Designed for elderly patients: large type, high contrast, a clear appointment guide and an interactive map.
Projects.expElcDesc: Logistics platform for a parcel carrier, integrating the major courier services behind one interface.
Projects.expElcB1: Integrations with courier APIs: InPost, Poczta Polska, GLS, Orlen Paczka, FedEx, UPS and Meest Post.
Projects.expElcB2: Automated waybill generation, parcel tracking and route optimisation on a Spring Boot backend.
Projects.expElcB3: React web client plus a React Native companion app sharing a single API.
Projects.expWaterDesc: Desktop application automating the analysis of water quality samples.
Projects.expWaterB1: Reads sensor data directly from laboratory equipment to detect bacterial strains such as E. coli.
Projects.expWaterB2: Generates PDF reports and maintains a historical database of water quality metrics.
Projects.ssVaultDesc: A secure vault encrypting files and passwords and managing GPG cryptographic keys behind a minimal graphical interface.
Projects.ssVaultLongDesc: ssVault is a security tool for personal data protection. It provides AES-256 encryption for files and passwords, using SQLCipher for secure database storage. The application offers a GUI for GPG key management, letting users import, export and generate keys. It is built with Electron for cross-platform compatibility.
Projects.driperskaLigaDesc: Tournament platform for amateur League of Legends leagues: team registration, a draft with a live draw stream, match results and standings.
Projects.tAccessDesc: Telegram bot selling access to private channels, built with Java, React and PostgreSQL.
Projects.tAccessLongDesc: TAccess acts as an automated sales agent for Telegram channels. It integrates with payment gateways to grant or revoke access based on subscription status. The admin panel, built with React, lets channel owners track revenue, manage subscribers and configure bot responses.
Projects.typengineDesc: A 2D game engine written in C++ that embeds TypeScript as its scripting language.
Projects.universalCliDesc: A command-line client for local LLMs and any OpenAI-compatible API, with filesystem tools that let the model read and write project files.
Projects.dishAtlasDesc: A mini-encyclopedia of well-known dishes from around the world, built with Kotlin and Jetpack Compose.
Projects.transitSimDesc: A simulation of a public transport network covering routes, timetables and passenger flow.
Projects.blockchainJavaDesc: A blockchain-like structure implemented from scratch in Java: block hashing, proof of work and chain validation.
